# noir/scripts/goldens/circuits.txt
#
# STRUCTURAL GOLDENS for the ZKM bin circuits (zkm_control_attestation,
# zkm_delegate_possession, zkm_issuance, zkm_mandate_transition,
# zkm_issuance_zkc, zkm_revocation_auth, zkm_spend_conjoined,
# zkm_spend_zkc_binding), generated by
# check-circuit-goldens.sh --bless.
#
# A diff against this file is a PROTOCOL CHANGE and requires review. It
# must NOT be blindly re-blessed to make CI green -- understand WHY each
# value moved before regenerating.
#
# Regenerate (only once you have reviewed and intend the change):
#   noir/scripts/check-circuit-goldens.sh --bless
#
# FIELDS (pipe-delimited):
#   package | vk_hash | public_input_count | acir_opcode_count | bytecode_sha256
#
#   vk_hash              - UltraHonk verification-key hash, read verbatim from
#                          bb write_vk's own <dir>/vk_hash (hex-dumped, never
#                          re-hashed by us). The deploy-cascade tripwire: a
#                          settlement layer pins a VK, so an unnoticed VK move
#                          silently invalidates deployed verifiers.
#   public_input_count   - Count of ABI parameters with visibility "public", in
#                          field-elements (u8/u64/u128/Field = 1 each).
#                          LOAD-BEARING SAFETY PROPERTY, twice over.
#                          zkm_mandate_transition carries NO ZKA VALUE LEG (no
#                          note root, no ZKA nullifier, no output commitments,
#                          no asset_id) -- that absence is what makes its VK
#                          "structurally incapable of authorizing value
#                          movement". zkm_control_attestation carries NO
#                          root_id -- that absence is what stops a disclosure
#                          recipient replaying it as a §7.1 revocation. If
#                          either count changes, the matching safety argument
#                          has broken and must be re-derived, not re-blessed
#                          away. (Both are stated in the circuits' own headers.)
#   acir_opcode_count    - `nargo info`'s ACIR-opcode count for `main`. Moves
#                          iff the circuit's constraint structure moves.
#   bytecode_sha256      - sha256 of the compiled `.bytecode` field ONLY, not
#                          the whole artifact JSON (which also carries
#                          toolchain/debug metadata that churns independent of
#                          the circuit).
#
